scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “A power saving for intersective polynomial differences with an exponent depending only on the degree” (preprints/A-power-saving-for-intersective-polynomial-differences-with-an-exponent-depending-only-on-the-degree-October-5-2026/power-saving-intersective-polynomial-differences.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 182 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d69e417ac953581d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every integer k ≥ 2, there is a constant ck ∈ (0, 1) with the following property. For every intersective polynomial h ∈ Z[x] of degree k with positive leading coefficient, there are a constant Ch ≥ 1 and an integer Nh ≥ 1 such that, whenever N ≥ Nh and A ⊆ [N] satisfy (A − A) ∩ h(N+) ⊆ {0}, one has |A| ≤ ChN1−ck .
